description: The main window. Each permission is named with the change that needs it (knowledge/conventions.md). core:event listen and unlisten since #04, so the window hears the result of an import by drop. Since the top bar of #07 is the title bar (knowledge/decision-app-shell.md): start-dragging and internal-toggle-maximize to drag the window by the bar and maximize it by a double click, minimize, toggle-maximize and close for the window buttons on Windows, is-maximized so the middle button shows Wiederherstellen. core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom since #53, for the sizes Klein, Mittel and Groß as the zoom of the webview.
